# ZONRI

> ZONRI (Zhongrui Electric Co., Ltd.) is a Chinese manufacturer and supplier of high-voltage electrical insulators, GFRP bushings, and ZnO lightning arresters for power transmission systems.

Based in Yueqing City within the Chinese Electric City, ZONRI specializes in composite insulators, pin insulators, post insulators, and lightning protection equipment for utility and industrial applications. The company provides technical resources and product information for electrical engineers and power system professionals.

## Key Topics

- Composite Insulators
- GFRP Bushings
- ZnO Lightning Arrester
- High Voltage Insulators
- Pin Insulators
- Post Insulators
- Zinc Oxide Arrester
- Power Transmission
- Electrical Equipment
- Lightning Protection
- DC Systems
- Composite Pin Insulator
- Y Type Composite Insulator
- Moisture Absorption
- High-Voltage Equipment
